instruction.text: Select the tree in this food chain to learn about producers.

feedback.end: Producers, like this acacia tree, are mostly plants. Producers are at the start of all food chains and get their energy from the Sun.

instruction.text: Which photo shows a producer? Select the correct picture.

feedback.correct: Grass is a producer. It is loved by sheep and many other farm animals!
The main producer in oceans and lakes is called algae. This seaweed is a type of algae.

instruction.text: Select the giraffe in this food chain to learn about consumers.

feedback.end: Consumers eat other living things for their energy. In this food chain, the giraffe and the lion are consumers.

instruction.text: Drag the pictures of the living things into the correct group, consumer or producer.

atoms.a: They are at the start of all food chains.
They eat living things to get their energy.
They come after plants in a food chain.
